about: Ground truth for the maintainer's second recording, the v0.5.1 evidence (docs/V0_5_1_VALIDATION.md): the first footage of Fortnite HUD Scale 75% that the 75% templates were NOT cut from (those come from 2026-11-12 12-52-32). Times are video seconds. Candidates: every frame's pop-up box scored with the standard and the 75% CHEST templates (blurred >= 0.70 anywhere in the box) and every lavender burst in the box; each candidate and each listed screen was confirmed by looking at the frames (a new pop-up opens with a light streak through the XP line; a camera turn changes only the background). A pop-up hidden by an overlay for its whole life would be missing. std / hud75 = what v0.5.0 (ec94cb1) counted with the profile's HUD Scale set to Standard / 75% (research/pipeline_baseline.py, whole video).

known_weakness: 361.5 s: with the 75% template the NEW STORM PHASE line added to a chest pop-up scored 0.73-0.79 (blurred) for a few frames, over the stacked tracker's 0.75 chest-line level (Standard template 0.63-0.71). The tracker counted it as an added chest line 0.4 s before the real second CHEST line (0.85-0.88) appeared, which then fell in the 0.6 s settle time. The total is right here only because a real chest followed; without one, that line would be one false APPROX. One example, so no threshold is changed (tests/cases user1114_chest_storm_phase_chest pins it).
